subject: RE: EdgeScale renewal — discount approval needed & commit status
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@edgescale.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>; Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edgescale.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: EdgeScale renewal — draft SOW and pricing question

Hi Tessa / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the run-through this morning. Attached is the draft SOW (v3) and a short note from our procurement team. We’re excited to expand usage across two additional product lines — that drives the ask below.

Quick question: finance at EdgeScale is pushing for a 35% discount off list starting on the renewal. That’s outside the list discount we originally budgeted for. Can Redwood confirm if that’s something you can support? If not, what’s the maximum concession you can offer and how would that affect timing to sign?

We’re aiming to get signature by end of this month so we can hit our internal go-live. Please let us know any requirements from your side (PO, SOW countersign, billing cadence).

Attachments: EdgeScale_SOW_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Procurement, EdgeScale
liam.oneill@edgescale.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@edgescale.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: RE: EdgeScale renewal — draft SOW and pricing question

Hi Liam — thanks for sending the SOW. I reviewed the ask with Vanessa and the commercial team. Quick notes and next steps: 

- We see the expansion and appreciate the scale — that makes this a high-priority review.
- Standard approval band for renewals capped at 25% without explicit deal-desk sign-off. 35% will require deal desk + finance approval and a short rationale (expansion motion, strategic reference, multi-year pre-pay, etc.).
- From a timing perspective, deal desk needs the final ACV, billing cadence (annual vs monthly), and whether EdgeScale will pre-pay/commit for 12 months. Can you confirm those three items by EOD Monday so we can accelerate?
- Please note: if approval is granted, Finance may require modified recognition rules for our forecast (partial-commit) until cash is received. We will confirm after review.

I’ve attached a short pricing summary for internal use (pricing-summary.xlsx) and looped in Ben for deal-desk prioritization.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing-summary.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Deal Desk <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Finance Ops <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: EdgeScale renewal — discount escalation (ES-2026-Q4-079)

Team —

Looping you in to request expedited deal-desk + finance review. Summary: EdgeScale (existing customer) is expanding and requesting a 35% renewal discount on a ~$720k ARR renewal (annual billing preferred). Tessa is leading the buy; they want to sign by 11/30 to meet their launch window.

Why consider: strategic expansion into two product lines, strong reference potential, and multi-year interest (they've hinted at a 2-year pre-pay if pricing works).

Requested ask: approve concession up to 35% or advise maximum allowable concession and any conditional terms (pre-pay, term length, revenue recognition constraints). Also advise whether we should mark this as "Committed" in the Q4 revenue forecast if the SOW is countersigned before month-end.

Attachments: pricing-summary.xlsx (attached)

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: RE: EdgeScale renewal — discount escalation (ES-2026-Q4-079)

Ben / Tessa / Vanessa —

We reviewed EdgeScale's request. Deal desk position: we can approve up to a 30% one-time concession under the following conditions: 

1) Payment terms: 12-month pre-pay (annual invoice) or 50% upfront + 50% on 60 days.
2) Term commitment: minimum 12 months; 2-year locked pricing only with additional margin protection (cap on future discounting).
3) Legal: SOW must be countersigned and DocuSign envelope completed. No verbal commitments accepted.

Important for forecast: discounts >25% require Finance confirmation before marking 100% committed. By default, Finance will allow partial commit (80% of ARR) until cash is received or a fully executed 12-month pre-pay is recorded. Please surface whether EdgeScale will agree to pre-pay; that materially changes forecast treatment.

I attached suggested redline points for the SOW (internal access) and the pricing breakdown. If EdgeScale confirms pre-pay, we can fast-track approval to final signoff.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Final approval — EdgeScale renewal (ES-2026-Q4-079)

All —

Finance has reviewed the deal desk recommendation and EdgeScale's commercials. Decision and instructions below: 

Decision: Approve a one-time 30% concession conditional on a 12-month pre-pay (annual invoice) OR 50/50 split with 60-day final payment. Given the strategic expansion, we will allow the concession as a limited exception.

Forecast treatment (critical): until cash is received (pre-pay) or a signed 12-month invoice posts, record 80% of the committed ACV in the Q4 forecast. The remaining 20% should be held as contingent and tracked separately. This means: update HubSpot to reflect "Commit - partial (80%)" and add a finance note with the deal_id ES-2026-Q4-079 and link to the DocuSign envelope.

Operational asks:
- Tessa: confirm which payment option EdgeScale selects and update HubSpot to the exact "Commit - partial (80%)" tag.
- Ben / Karthik: finalize DocuSign and upload countersigned SOW to the Drive link and HubSpot record.
- Vanessa: Customer success to accelerate onboarding timeline once payment posts.

Attachments: pricing-summary.xlsx, EdgeScale_SOW_v3.pdf
Related links: https://hubspot.com/contacts/ES-2026-Q4-079, https://docusign.com/EdgeScale_ES-2026-Q4-079

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
